title: Harnessing Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning
caption: Figure 1. Illustration of the forward process and the reverse pro- cess of diffusion models. (a) With the increase of noise, the image first loses low-level texture information and then loses high-level shape information. (b) Denoising at low time step t1, recovering texture information. (c) Denoising at high time step t4, recover- ing texture and shape information. From this figure, we can see that learning via image denoising inevitably introduces low-level information, failing to sufficiently focus on high-level information related to semantics.
